test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: 56 persons can repair a bridge in 20 days. If 14 more people join them, then how many days bridge can be repaired?
solution:
Given:

Person = 56

Time = 20 days

Formula used:

Work = Number of days (Time) (T or D) × Number of men (M). 

M1 × D1 = M2 × D2

Calculation

Let the number of days by 14 more men to do the work be D2.

⇒ 56 × 20 = (56 + 14) × D2

⇒ D2 = (56 × 20) / 70

⇒ D2 = 16 days

**∴ Total number of days is 16.**
